column1: # browser components: kind  name  key  description  flags (see lib/components.sh)
# Rows come from every Chromium-family and Firefox profile; enter opens the URLs in the browser and profile
# they came from and closes, ctrl-o opens them and stays.
mode    history    -       history, newest first across profiles                        default
toggle  chrome     -       Chrome, Chromium, Brave and Vivaldi profiles                 on
sort    recent     -       history: last visited first                                  default,desc
sort    visits     -       history: most visited first                                  -
action  open       -       open in the row's browser and profile, then close            become,default
action  open-stay  ctrl-o  open in the row's browser and profile                        silent
action  xdg        alt-o   open in the default browser (xdg-open)                        silent
action  copy       ctrl-y  copy the URLs                                                silent,builtin
action  copy-title  alt-y   copy the titles                                             notify
